verses.original: הָיָ֥ה אִ֛ישׁ בְאֶֽרֶץ־ ע֖וּץ שְׁמ֑וֹ אִיּ֣וֹב הָאִ֣ישׁ וְהָיָ֣ה׀ הַה֗וּא תָּ֧ם וְיָשָׁ֛ר וִירֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְסָ֥ר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yāh ’îš ḇə·’e·reṣ- ‘ūṣ šə·mōw ’î·yō·wḇ hā·’îš wə·hā·yāh ha·hū tām wə·yā·šār wî·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·sār mê·rā‘
verses.literal: There was a man in the land of Uz whose name [was] Job And this man was blameless and upright fearing God and shunning evil

verses.original: וַיִּוָּ֥לְדוּ ל֛וֹ שִׁבְעָ֥ה בָנִ֖ים וְשָׁל֥וֹשׁ בָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiw·wā·lə·ḏū lōw šiḇ·‘āh ḇā·nîm wə·šā·lō·wōš bā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: - He had seven sons and three daughters

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י מִ֠קְנֵהוּ שִֽׁבְעַ֨ת אַלְפֵי־ צֹ֜אן וּשְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אַלְפֵ֣י גְמַלִּ֗ים וַחֲמֵ֨שׁ מֵא֤וֹת צֶֽמֶד־ בָּקָר֙ וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֲתוֹנ֔וֹת מְאֹ֑ד וַיְהִי֙ רַבָּ֣ה וַעֲבֻדָּ֖ה הַה֔וּא גָּד֖וֹל הָאִ֣ישׁ מִכָּל־ בְּנֵי־ קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·nê·hū šiḇ·‘aṯ ’al·p̄ê- ṣōn ū·šə·lō·šeṯ ’al·p̄ê ḡə·mal·lîm wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ ṣe·meḏ- bā·qār wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ ’ă·ṯō·w·nō·wṯ mə·’ōḏ way·hî rab·bāh wa·‘ă·ḇud·dāh ha·hū gā·ḏō·wl hā·’îš mik·kāl bə·nê- qe·ḏem
verses.literal: and he owned . . . 7,000 {} . . . sheep 3,000 {} . . . camels 500 . . . yoke of oxen 500 . . . female donkeys and a very . . . large number of servants [Job was] the greatest man of all the people of the East

verses.original: בָנָיו֙ וְהָלְכ֤וּ וְעָשׂ֣וּ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה בֵּ֖ית אִ֣ישׁ יוֹמ֑וֹ וְשָׁלְח֗וּ וְקָרְאוּ֙ לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אַחְיֹתֵיהֶם לֶאֱכֹ֥ל וְלִשְׁתּ֖וֹת עִמָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḇā·nāw wə·hā·lə·ḵū wə·‘ā·śū miš·teh bêṯ ’îš yō·w·mōw wə·šā·lə·ḥū wə·qā·rə·’ū liš·lō·šeṯ ʾaḥ·yō·ṯē·hɛm le·’ĕ·ḵōl wə·liš·tō·wṯ ‘im·mā·hem
verses.literal: [Job’s] sons would take turns holding feasts in their homes . . . . . . and they would invite . . . their three sisters to eat and drink with them

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י כִּ֣י יְמֵ֨י הַמִּשְׁתֶּ֜ה הִקִּיפֽוּ֩ אִיּ֣וֹב וַיִּשְׁלַ֧ח וַֽיְקַדְּשֵׁ֗ם וְהִשְׁכִּ֣ים בַּבֹּקֶר֮ וְהֶעֱלָ֣ה עֹלוֹת֮ מִסְפַּ֣ר כֻּלָּם֒ כִּ֚י אִיּ֔וֹב אָמַ֣ר אוּלַי֙ בָנַ֔י חָטְא֣וּ וּבֵרֲכ֥וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בִּלְבָבָ֑ם כָּ֛כָה אִיּ֖וֹב כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃פ יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî yə·mê ham·miš·teh hiq·qî·p̄ū ’î·yō·wḇ way·yiš·laḥ way·qad·də·šêm wə·hiš·kîm bab·bō·qer wə·he·‘ĕ·lāh ‘ō·lō·wṯ mis·par kul·lām kî ’î·yō·wḇ ’ā·mar ’ū·lay ḇā·nay ḥā·ṭə·’ū ū·ḇê·ră·ḵū ’ĕ·lō·hîm bil·ḇā·ḇām kā·ḵāh ’î·yō·wḇ kāl- hay·yā·mîm ya·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: And when the days of feasting were over Job would send [for his children] to purify them rising early in the morning to offer burnt offerings . . . for all of them For Job thought Perhaps my children have sinned and cursed God in their hearts This was Job’s regular . . . practice

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם בְּנֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־ יְהוָ֑ה הַשָּׂטָ֖ן גַֽם־ וַיָּב֥וֹא בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hay·yō·wm bə·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yā·ḇō·’ū lə·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ‘al- Yah·weh haś·śā·ṭān ḡam- way·yā·ḇō·w bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: - One day the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD and Satan also came with them

verses.original: מֵאַ֣יִן תָּבֹ֑א וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֖ן מִשּׁ֣וּט בָּאָ֔רֶץ הַשָּׂטָ֤ן אֶת־ יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר וַיַּ֨עַן וּמֵֽהִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’a·yin tā·ḇō way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- haś·śā·ṭān miš·šūṭ bā·’ā·reṣ haś·śā·ṭān ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·yō·mar way·ya·‘an ū·mê·hiṯ·hal·lêḵ bāh
verses.literal: Where have you come from said the LORD to Satan From roaming through the earth he - - . . . replied and walking back and forth in it

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן הֲשַׂ֥מְתָּ לִבְּךָ֖ עַל־ עַבְדִּ֣י אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין בָּאָ֔רֶץ כָּמֹ֙הוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֧ם וְיָשָׁ֛ר יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְסָ֥ר מֵרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- haś·śā·ṭān hă·śam·tā lib·bə·ḵā ‘al- ‘aḇ·dî ’î·yō·wḇ kî ’ên bā·’ā·reṣ kā·mō·hū ’îš tām wə·yā·šār yə·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·sār mê·rā‘
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Satan Have you considered . . . . . . My servant Job For [there is] no one on earth like him a man [who is] blameless and upright who fears God and shuns evil

verses.original: הַשָּׂטָ֛ן אֶת־ וַיַּ֧עַן יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אִיּ֖וֹב יָרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִֽים׃ הַֽחִנָּ֔ם
verses.transliteration: haś·śā·ṭān ’eṯ- way·ya·‘an Yah·weh way·yō·mar ’î·yō·wḇ yā·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ha·ḥin·nām
verses.literal: Satan - answered the LORD . . . Does Job fear God for nothing

verses.original: הֲלֹֽא־ אַתְּ שַׂ֣כְתָּ מִסָּבִ֑יב בַעֲד֧וֹ וּבְעַד־ בֵּית֛וֹ וּבְעַ֥ד כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֖וֹ בֵּרַ֔כְתָּ מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדָיו֙ וּמִקְנֵ֖הוּ פָּרַ֥ץ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- ʾat śaḵ·tā mis·sā·ḇîḇ ḇa·‘ă·ḏōw ū·ḇə·‘aḏ- bê·ṯōw ū·ḇə·‘aḏ kāl- ’ă·šer- lōw bê·raḵ·tā ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏāw ū·miq·nê·hū pā·raṣ bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Have You not . . . placed a hedge on every side around him . . . and his household and all that he owns You have blessed the work of his hands and his possessions have increased in the land

verses.original: וְאוּלָם֙ שְֽׁלַֽח־ נָ֣א יָֽדְךָ֔ וְגַ֖ע בְּכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֑וֹ אִם־ לֹ֥א יְבָרֲכֶֽךָּ׃ עַל־ פָּנֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām šə·laḥ- nā yā·ḏə·ḵā wə·ḡa‘ bə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- lōw ’im- lō yə·ḇā·ră·ḵe·kā ‘al- pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: But stretch out . . . Your hand and strike all that he has and he will surely . . . curse You to Your face

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֗ן כָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ רַ֣ק אַל־ תִּשְׁלַ֖ח יָדֶ֑ךָ אֵלָ֔יו הַשָּׂטָ֔ן מֵעִ֖ם וַיֵּצֵא֙ פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- haś·śā·ṭān ḵāl ’ă·šer- lōw bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā raq ’al- tiš·laḥ yā·ḏe·ḵā ’ê·lāw haś·śā·ṭān mê·‘im way·yê·ṣê pə·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Very well said the LORD to Satan Everything - he has [is] in your hands but you must not lay a hand on the man himself Then Satan . . . went out from the presence of the LORD

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י הַיּ֑וֹם וּבָנָ֨יו וּבְנֹתָ֤יו אֹֽכְלִים֙ וְשֹׁתִ֣ים יַ֔יִן הַבְּכֽוֹר׃ אֲחִיהֶ֥ם בְּבֵ֖ית
verses.transliteration: way·hî hay·yō·wm ū·ḇā·nāw ū·ḇə·nō·ṯāw ’ō·ḵə·lîm wə·šō·ṯîm ya·yin hab·bə·ḵō·wr ’ă·ḥî·hem bə·ḇêṯ
verses.literal: - One day while Job’s sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house

verses.original: וּמַלְאָ֛ךְ בָּ֥א וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֶל־ אִיּ֖וֹב הַבָּקָר֙ הָי֣וּ חֹֽרְשׁ֔וֹת וְהָאֲתֹנ֖וֹת רֹע֥וֹת עַל־ יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mal·’āḵ bā way·yō·mar ’el- ’î·yō·wḇ hab·bā·qār hā·yū ḥō·rə·šō·wṯ wə·hā·’ă·ṯō·nō·wṯ rō·‘ō·wṯ ‘al- yə·ḏê·hem
verses.literal: a messenger came and reported to Job While the oxen were plowing and the donkeys were grazing nearby . . .

verses.original: שְׁבָא֙ וַתִּפֹּ֤ל וַתִּקָּחֵ֔ם וְאֶת־ הִכּ֣וּ הַנְּעָרִ֖ים לְפִי־ חָ֑רֶב אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י וָֽאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק־ לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ḇā wat·tip·pōl wat·tiq·qā·ḥêm wə·’eṯ- hik·kū han·nə·‘ā·rîm lə·p̄î- ḥā·reḇ ’ă·nî lə·ḇad·dî wā·’im·mā·lə·ṭāh raq- lə·hag·gîḏ lāḵ
verses.literal: the Sabeans swooped down and took them away - They put the servants vvv to the sword and I alone have escaped . . . to tell you

verses.original: זֶ֣ה ע֣וֹד׀ מְדַבֵּ֗ר וְזֶה֮ בָּ֣א וַיֹּאמַר֒ אֵ֣שׁ אֱלֹהִ֗ים נָֽפְלָה֙ מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַתִּבְעַ֥ר וַתֹּאכְלֵ֑ם בַּצֹּ֛אן וּבַנְּעָרִ֖ים אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י וָאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק־ לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: zeh ‘ō·wḏ mə·ḏab·bêr wə·zeh bā way·yō·mar ’êš ’ĕ·lō·hîm nā·p̄ə·lāh min- haš·šā·ma·yim wat·tiḇ·‘ar wat·tō·ḵə·lêm baṣ·ṣōn ū·ḇan·nə·‘ā·rîm ’ă·nî lə·ḇad·dî wā·’im·mā·lə·ṭāh raq- lə·hag·gîḏ lāḵ
verses.literal: While he was still speaking another messenger came and reported The fire of God fell from heaven It burned and consumed the sheep and the servants and I alone have escaped . . . to tell you

verses.original: ע֣וֹד׀ זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֗ר וְזֶה֮ בָּ֣א וַיֹּאמַר֒ כַּשְׂדִּ֞ים שָׂ֣מוּ׀ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁ֗ים וַֽיִּפְשְׁט֤וּ עַל־ הַגְּמַלִּים֙ וַיִּקָּח֔וּם וְאֶת־ הִכּ֣וּ הַנְּעָרִ֖ים לְפִי־ חָ֑רֶב אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י וָאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק־ לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ zeh mə·ḏab·bêr wə·zeh bā way·yō·mar kaś·dîm śā·mū šə·lō·šāh rā·šîm way·yip̄·šə·ṭū ‘al- hag·gə·mal·lîm way·yiq·qā·ḥūm wə·’eṯ- hik·kū han·nə·‘ā·rîm lə·p̄î- ḥā·reḇ ’ă·nî lə·ḇad·dî wā·’im·mā·lə·ṭāh raq- lə·hag·gîḏ lāḵ
verses.literal: While he was still speaking another [messenger] came and reported The Chaldeans formed three bands raided the camels and took them away - They put the servants vvv to the sword and I alone have escaped . . . to tell you

verses.original: עַ֚ד זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֔ר וְזֶ֖ה בָּ֣א וַיֹּאמַ֑ר בָּנֶ֨יךָ וּבְנוֹתֶ֤יךָ אֹֽכְלִים֙ וְשֹׁתִ֣ים יַ֔יִן הַבְּכֽוֹר׃ אֲחִיהֶ֥ם בְּבֵ֖ית
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ zeh mə·ḏab·bêr wə·zeh bā way·yō·mar bā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·ḵā ’ō·ḵə·lîm wə·šō·ṯîm ya·yin hab·bə·ḵō·wr ’ă·ḥî·hem bə·ḇêṯ
verses.literal: While he was still speaking another messenger came and reported Your sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֩ גְּדוֹלָ֜ה ר֨וּחַ בָּ֣אָה׀ מֵעֵ֣בֶר הַמִּדְבָּ֗ר וַיִּגַּע֙ בְּאַרְבַּע֙ פִּנּ֣וֹת הַבַּ֔יִת וַיִּפֹּ֥ל עַל־ הַנְּעָרִ֖ים וַיָּמ֑וּתוּ אֲנִ֛י לְבַדִּ֖י וָאִמָּ֨לְטָ֧ה רַק־ לְהַגִּ֥יד לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh gə·ḏō·w·lāh rū·aḥ bā·’āh mê·‘ê·ḇer ham·miḏ·bār way·yig·ga‘ bə·’ar·ba‘ pin·nō·wṯ hab·ba·yiṯ way·yip·pōl ‘al- han·nə·‘ā·rîm way·yā·mū·ṯū ’ă·nî lə·ḇad·dî wā·’im·mā·lə·ṭāh raq- lə·hag·gîḏ lāḵ
verses.literal: when suddenly a mighty wind swept in from the desert and struck the four corners of the house It collapsed on the young people and they are dead and I alone have escaped . . . to tell you

verses.original: אִיּוֹב֙ וַיָּ֤קָם וַיִּקְרַ֣ע אֶת־ מְעִל֔וֹ וַיָּ֖גָז אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיִּפֹּ֥ל אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·yō·wḇ way·yā·qām way·yiq·ra‘ ’eṯ- mə·‘i·lōw way·yā·ḡāz ’eṯ- rō·šōw way·yip·pōl ’ar·ṣāh way·yiš·tā·ḥū
verses.literal: Then Job stood up tore - his robe and shaved - his head He fell to the ground and worshiped

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ עָרֹ֨ם יָצָתִי אִמִּ֗י מִבֶּ֣טֶן וְעָרֹם֙ אָשׁ֣וּב שָׁ֔מָה יְהוָ֣ה נָתַ֔ן וַיהוָ֖ה לָקָ֑ח מְבֹרָֽךְ׃ יְהִ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ‘ā·rōm yå̄·ṣå̄·ṯī ’im·mî mib·be·ṭen wə·‘ā·rōm ’ā·šūḇ šå̄·må̄h Yah·weh nā·ṯan Yah·weh lā·qāḥ mə·ḇō·rāḵ yə·hî šêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: saying Naked I came from my mother’s womb and naked I will return . . . The LORD gave and the LORD has taken away Blessed be the name of the LORD

verses.original: בְּכָל־ זֹ֖את אִיּ֑וֹב לֹא־ חָטָ֣א וְלֹא־ נָתַ֥ן לֵאלֹהִֽים׃פ תִּפְלָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl zōṯ ’î·yō·wḇ lō- ḥā·ṭā wə·lō- nā·ṯan lê·lō·hîm tip̄·lāh
verses.literal: In all this Job did not sin or charge God with wrongdoing
